SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STAMINA.title: ◆ Stamina
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STAMINA.description: Attacks cost ◆ (the orb under the energy cost). Below half the pool you are [gold]Tired[/gold] (−25% attack damage). An attack you cannot pay for leaves you [gold]Exhausted[/gold] (−50%) and costs 2 HP per missing ◆. Carries over between turns and regenerates each turn.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MANA.title: ✦ Mana
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MANA.description: Spells cost ✦. Every hero has mana; the price depends on your mastery of the spell's school. Combat starts at half the pool; unspent ✦ carries over.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BURDEN.title: ⚖ Burden
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BURDEN.description: Total weight of your deck and relics against your capacity. Overload 1–5: −1 ◆ regeneration; 6–10: also −1 card in the opening hand; above 10: you cannot pick up anything else.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WEIGHT.title: Weight
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WEIGHT.description: How much this card adds to your [gold]Burden[/gold]. Basic, common and uncommon — 1, rare — 2, curses — 2, statuses — 0. [gold]Lightened[/gold] cards weigh less.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-TIRED.title: Tired
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-TIRED.description: Less than half of your ◆ pool is left: attacks deal 25% less damage.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-EXHAUSTED.title: Exhausted
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-EXHAUSTED.description: Not enough ◆ to pay for this attack: it deals 50% less damage.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OVERSTRAIN.title: Overstrain
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OVERSTRAIN.description: You can still play an attack without enough ◆ — each missing ◆ costs 2 HP.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SNEAK.title: Sneak
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SNEAK.description: A sneak attack: the target has no attack intent, or you are [gold]Invisible[/gold] / used [gold]Muffled Steps[/gold]. Cards with "Sneak:" get their extra effect; daggers deal ×1.5.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHOUT.title: Shout
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHOUT.description: After it is played the Shout is shelved and returns to your hand after its cooldown (3 turns by default).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WEAPONATTACK.title: Weapon attack
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WEAPONATTACK.description: A Strike or weapon card: your equipped weapon's bonuses and its ◆ discount apply.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FIRE.title: Fire damage
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FIRE.description: Burning: bursts at the end of the target's turn, melts Block (×2) and halves each turn. Resistance I/II/III: −25/−50/−75%; vulnerability: +50%.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FROST.title: Frost damage
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FROST.description: Also drains as much ◆. Chill takes ◆ every turn; at 0 ◆ the target is Frozen. Resistance I/II/III: −25/−50/−75%; vulnerability: +50%.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHOCK.title: Shock damage
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHOCK.description: Also burns as much ✦. Static takes ✦ every turn; without mana it shocks for HP. Resistance I/II/III: −25/−50/−75%; vulnerability: +50%.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-POISON.title: Poison damage
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-POISON.description: Vanilla Poison: ticks at the start of turn, ignores Block, −1 each turn. Resistance reduces stacks. Resistance I/II/III: −25/−50/−75%; vulnerability: +50%.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BLIGHT.title: Blight
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BLIGHT.description: Forbids healing and Regeneration; every Poison tick deals extra damage. Undead and constructs are immune. Resistance I/II/III: −25/−50/−75%; vulnerability: +50%.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAGIC.title: Magic damage
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAGIC.description: Magic resistance reduces it. Ordinary Block, Ward, caps and special defenses still apply. Resistance I/II/III: −25/−50/−75%; vulnerability: +50%.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-LIGHT.title: Light damage
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-LIGHT.description: ×2 against undead, vampires and the Abyss, ignoring their spell absorption. Normal damage to others.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-TRUEDAMAGE.title: True damage
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-TRUEDAMAGE.description: Ignores Plating, Sunder and resistances, but not ordinary Block, damage caps (such as Intangible) or special invulnerability. Weak/Vulnerable and stamina still apply to powered attacks.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-REQUIREDSTAMINA.title: ◆ Required stamina
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-REQUIREDSTAMINA.descripti: This Skill requires its full, fixed ◆ cost. Not enough stamina: it cannot be played; no HP overstrain. Attack discounts and Tired/Exhausted damage penalties do not apply. Replays pay only once.
